conflicts.permit: We use an opt-out standard for all communications other than administrative communication concerning your account.
conflicts.prohibit: Such marketing communications will only be sent to you if you have consented thereto through an ‘Opt-in’.
conflicts.situation: A registered member who never opted in receives promotional emails about specials and new services using their email address.
conflicts.reason: One statement makes marketing email opt-out by default, the other requires prior opt-in consent; the policy gives no precedence or scope difference between the two.

conflicts.permit: In order to maintain a healthy community, we cooperate with all law enforcement inquiries and with all third parties to enforce their intellectual property or other rights.
conflicts.prohibit: Other than a valid request from a legal authority your information is secure on the Website.
conflicts.situation: A private rights holder, not a legal authority, asks the site for a member's information to enforce its intellectual property rights.
conflicts.reason: The policy says it cooperates with all third parties enforcing rights but also limits release to valid legal-authority requests; it does not say which governs private requests.

conflicts.permit: Cookies are a normal part of internet operations and are also used by the Website to safely identify you each time you logon and use the Website, and to keep your session active when you don’t use the website for a period of time.
conflicts.prohibit: Any information that us or third parties collect via cookies and marketing campaigns tracking software is totally anonymous.
conflicts.situation: A member logs in and the site's cookie collects information used to identify that member during the session.
conflicts.reason: Cookie data used to identify the user cannot be totally anonymous; the policy states no exception for login cookies.

conflicts.permit: Your personal information voluntarily provided by yourself is disclosed with other users through your public profile.
conflicts.prohibit: However, NONE of your personally identifiable information can be accessed or used by the public to identify a specific individual.
conflicts.situation: A member's profile photographs and geographical location are shown to other users on the public profile.
conflicts.reason: Profile content includes photographs and location that can identify a person, yet the policy says no personally identifiable information is publicly accessible; it does not reconcile the two.

conflicts.permit: Depending on your Google account settings, AdMob may collect and use personally identifiable information to serve personalized ads
conflicts.prohibit: Data obtained regarding your location is only used to query for search results near your location (which is the main purpose of the app) and to display your location and the serach results within the app, e.g. on a map.
conflicts.situation: A user of the free version grants location permission while AdMob, embedded in the app, collects location data to serve personalized ads.
conflicts.reason: AdMob's listed collection includes location data for ads, while location data is said to be used only for search results and display; the policy does not separate the two sources.

conflicts.permit: For example, if you consented to and enabled precise geographic location when using our App or Site, we may use this information to provide you with Great Clips® salon locations and distances to such locations.
conflicts.prohibit: We will only process Sensitive Personal Information where it is necessary for the purposes of complying with our legal obligations or exercising specific rights as permitted by law.
conflicts.situation: A user enables precise geolocation in the App and Great Clips uses it to show nearby salons and distances.
conflicts.reason: Precise geolocation is defined as sensitive, and showing salons is not a legal obligation; the example appears in the same section without stating an exception to the restriction.

conflicts.permit: Process payment transactions related to services; (process payroll)
conflicts.prohibit: We will only process Sensitive Personal Information where it is necessary for the purposes of complying with our legal obligations or exercising specific rights as permitted by law.
conflicts.situation: A customer enters a credit card number in the App to pay for a salon service.
conflicts.reason: The table lists financial information as sensitive and processes it for payments, which is not a legal obligation; the policy does not carve payments out of the restriction.

conflicts.prohibit: Employer HR system only for application/employment purposes
conflicts.situation: An employee's health insurance information collected for emergency documentation is disclosed to a government authority.
conflicts.reason: Health insurance information appears in two table rows: one lists government authorities as recipients, the other limits disclosure to the HR system only; the policy does not say which row governs.

conflicts.permit: When you use certain online tax services, IP addresses and unique device IDs may be tied to personal information to enable users to file or transmit tax returns to the IRS.
conflicts.prohibit: Our collection of website traffic information is anonymized and does not include personally identifiable information.
conflicts.situation: A user prepares a return on the website, and the IP address recorded from the visit is linked to the user's identity for e-filing.
conflicts.reason: Both statements cover IP addresses collected during website visits; the policy classifies IP addresses as personal information and does not say how traffic data relates to log file data tied to identity.

conflicts.permit: We share your Individual Information and Usage Information with the Auction House for their business purposes, including marketing purposes.
conflicts.prohibit: We use this information only to improve the Services, but do not combine it with personally identifiable information.
conflicts.situation: Website usage data collected through Google Analytics is passed to the Auction House for its marketing.
conflicts.reason: Analytics data from the website falls within automatically collected Usage Information, which is shared for marketing, yet that data is said to be used only to improve the Services; no precedence is stated.
